_note: scenario/action id -> the source line shown as this pack's citation for that content. Same contract mvf_pack_safety.citation_for() reads for VAC: citations.get(id) or citations.get('_default') over the WHOLE parsed file, no wrapper key. structural_report()'s own probe only checks that '_default' resolves; every other key below is real content-to-source mapping, not filler.
_default: See plan/PIVOT/ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md and plan/REPORTS/ERP_SOURCES_2026-08-07.md for the full source register this pack draws from.
basic_stay_in_vehicle: US National Weather Service winter storm guidance ('Stay in the vehicle!'); echoed by Public Safety Canada and a road safety regulator. VERIFIED, unanimous, unconditional - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 3b.
basic_clear_exhaust: Public Safety Canada, a road safety regulator, and the US National Weather Service, four bodies total. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 3b.
basic_crack_window: US National Weather Service. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 3b.
basic_run_engine_intermittent: US National Weather Service publishes 'about 10 minutes each hour'; a second body publishes 'only sporadically' with no number. VERIFIED, UNRECONCILED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 3b. Printed with its disagreement stated, never as consensus.
basic_visible_marker: US National Weather Service and a road safety regulator (bright cloth on the antenna; raise the hood only after snow stops falling). VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 3b.
basic_move_body: US National Weather Service and a road safety regulator, published under general cold-exposure guidance. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 3b.
basic_phone_charged_call_911: A road safety regulator (Transport Canada-style: keep the phone charged, carry a cable, call 911); a weather service lists phone/charger/batteries as the first item in a vehicle kit; CRTC and a BC search and rescue association on any-tower 911 access. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.3.
bush_stay_put: US National Park Service, Mountain Rescue England and Wales, AdventureSmart's Hug-a-Tree programme. VERIFIED, unanimous in public-facing copy - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.1.
bush_trip_plan: Ontario Search and Rescue Volunteer Association (OSARVA): staying put works 'as long as the missing or lost person(s) can reasonably expect a search to be organized on his/her behalf in the very near future.' VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.1.
bush_deviation_withheld: ERP_PARTNER_QUESTIONS.md A0-1, A0-2, A0-6, all BLOCKING, unanswered.
bush_groups_of_three: OSARVA (any distress signal in groups of three) and a Government of Canada DND air cadet publication (three fires, 35 metres/100 feet apart). VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2.
bush_visual_signal_size: Government of Canada DND air cadet manual: signals 3m wide, 10m long if possible, 3m apart; geometric shapes read as human-made before detail resolves. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2.
bush_stay_with_signal: AdventureSmart: 'Always remain as close to your signal source as possible.' VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2.
bush_shelter_tradeoff: OSARVA: a built shelter can create a camouflaging effect that hides a lost person from searchers. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2. Stated as a genuine trade-off, not resolved either way.
bush_whistle_over_voice: US National Park Service (energy), a Government of Canada DND publication (acoustic design), OSARVA and AdventureSmart (stop periodically so you can hear a reply). VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2.
bush_ground_to_air_chart_withheld: ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2: the IAMSAR chart is sold under copyright; Canada's own CAMSAR supplement does not contain it; two Canadian bodies' five-symbol sets differ in two of five entries.
bush_phone_911_any_tower: CRTC (basic wireless 911 service with no active subscription) and a BC search and rescue association (connects to any cell tower in range). VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.3.
bush_phone_no_text_911: CRTC: text-to-911 is a registered service for hearing/speech impaired Canadians who must dial first; not generally available. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.3.
bush_phone_on_or_off_withheld: ERP_PARTNER_QUESTIONS.md B1, B2, BLOCKING. ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.3 finds a genuine, unreconciled conflict inside Canadian official sources.
bush_boil_water: Health Canada: rolling boil for 1 minute inactivates waterborne bacteria, protozoa and viruses; at least 2 minutes above 2000m. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.4.
bush_boiling_does_not_fix_everything: Health Canada and US CDC: boiling does not address chemical or radiological contamination. VERIFIED, both - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.4.
bush_do_not_eat_snow: US National Weather Service: eating unmelted snow lowers body temperature. VERIFIED. No Canadian federal equivalent was found - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.4.
bush_keep_one_reference: Souman, Frissen, Sreenivasan, Ernst, 'Walking Straight Into Circles', Current Biology, 2009: participants who could not see the sun walked in circles; a visible reference stopped it. VERIFIED, peer-reviewed - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.5b.
bush_phone_compass_limits: Apple and Android's own developer documentation (true heading needs a location fix; magnetic heading does not); NRCan on declination variability increasing toward the north. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.5.
bush_navigation_technique_withheld: ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 1: no recognised SAR body publishes a taught navigation procedure for a person currently lost. Basic navigation ships as a separate learning pack, plan/PIVOT/LEARNING_PACKS_SPEC.md.
bush_moss_debunked: A US state conservation agency's own myth-busting material: moss growing does not reliably indicate north. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.5c.
bush_tree_branches_debunked: A municipal parks authority: tree branches point in all directions and the method is not as reliable as a compass. VERIFIED, municipal source tier - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.5c.
bush_folklore_unresolved: ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.5c: NOTHING FOUND, either direction, for tree ring asymmetry, snow melt patterns, or prevailing wind.
bush_no_food_identification: Peer-reviewed measurement of plant and mushroom identification apps: species-level accuracy as low as 44-58%, poisonous species misidentified as edible, and a poisons information centre observing an increase in poisonings after app-guided misidentification. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.7.
bush_radio_licence_exempt: ISED Canada standards: FRS and GMRS licence-exempt under RSS-210; CB Channel 9 reserved for emergency communications; marine VHF Channel 16 monitored by the Coast Guard 24/7. VERIFIED - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.6.
bush_radio_beacon: 406 MHz personal locator beacons: any signal received is treated as a positive indication of distress. VERIFIED, framed operationally rather than as a marine-carriage rule generalised - ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.6.
bush_radio_legal_unresolved: ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.6: no explicit distress exception was located in the Radiocommunication Act or its regulations; absence of a found provision is not proof none exists. UNVERIFIED, stated as unknown rather than guessed.
